title: Whole Enlargement and Empty Print Drying Workcorner

All original local GLB coordinates, normals, hierarchy and full PBR are preserved; only one unit-scale rigid parent rotation and translations place the complete originals. No chemical baths, liquids, paper, image, red safelight or working darkroom process is supplied. Static composition only: no optical exposure, photographic development, drying effectiveness, equipment fit, ergonomic access, actual lifting, load, stability, chemical or electrical safety claim. No rigging, animation or interaction.
